answer: Gate sybils with a three-stage age ladder, not deposits. One, the dune: each identity accrues signed-work credit at a fixed per-epoch rate; payment cannot speed it. Two, the canyon: before grading or claiming shares, a randomized audit samples logged work, and failure burns all accrued credit. Three, the summit: only accounts holding K audited epochs get non-transferable signing weight. Farming n puppets means rebuilding n ladders from zero; rotation zeroes the dune, so pre-farming and parallel reset fail. Marginal cost is n carry prices: linear, per-identity, enforced.
